summary: misilva73 的 EIP-8037 更新合并：为每字节状态成本加入量化方案，并用储备模型取代基于回滚的 TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT 限制。lightclient 提交放宽 EIP-8141 中 APPROVE 必须由顶层 frame 调用的要求，方便现有智能账户采用。CarlBeek 在 Magicians 论证 Hegotá 引入 Quick Slots。

items.title: EIP-8037：加入量化、储备模型并细化 gas 记账
items.note: （misilva73）合并，2 月 9 日提交：cost_per_state_byte 采用取最高 4 个有效位的量化方案，避免随 gas limit 波动频繁小幅变化；用储备模型取代基于回滚的 TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT 限制，把执行 gas 拆为 gas_left 与 state_gas_reservoir；EIP-8007：加入 gas 成本摘要（misilva73）提交并合并。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: add quantization, a reservoir model and refined gas accounting
items.note_en: (misilva73), merged after submission on February 9: cost_per_state_byte is quantized to its top 4 significant bits so it does not change in small steps as the gas limit moves, and revert based TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT enforcement is replaced by a reservoir model splitting execution gas into gas_left and state_gas_reservoir; EIP-8007: add gas cost summaries (misilva73), submitted and merged.

items.title: EIP-8007：加入 gas 成本摘要
items.note: EIP-8037：加入量化、储备模型并细化 gas 记账（misilva73）合并，2 月 9 日提交：cost_per_state_byte 采用取最高 4 个有效位的量化方案，避免随 gas limit 波动频繁小幅变化；用储备模型取代基于回滚的 TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT 限制，把执行 gas 拆为 gas_left 与 state_gas_reservoir；EIP-8007：加入 gas 成本摘要（misilva73）提交并合并。
items.note_en: EIP-8037: add quantization, a reservoir model and refined gas accounting (misilva73), merged after submission on February 9: cost_per_state_byte is quantized to its top 4 significant bits so it does not change in small steps as the gas limit moves, and revert based TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT enforcement is replaced by a reservoir model splitting execution gas into gas_left and state_gas_reservoir; EIP-8007: add gas cost summaries (misilva73), submitted and merged.

items.title: EIP-8141：放宽 APPROVE 必须由顶层调用 frame 调用的要求
items.note: （lightclient）提交：此前要求账户退出顶层 frame 时调用 APPROVE，但现有智能账户都不支持这个 8141 才有的操作码；放宽后，用代理部署的智能账户可以更换实现来采用 8141。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: relax the requirement that APPROVE be called by the top level call frame
items.note_en: (lightclient), submitted: accounts previously had to exit the top level frame with APPROVE, which no current smart account supports since the opcode only exists with 8141; relaxing it lets proxy deployed smart accounts adopt 8141 by switching implementations.
